properties.name: move characteristic
properties.source_quote: It may move a characteristic, up or down, by 1 and never more in one moment.

properties.name: bind standing
properties.source_quote: It may bind a standing: a person, a place, or a faction becomes ally, enemy, debt, obligation, or acquaintance to the character.

properties.name: leave mark
properties.source_quote: It may leave a mark: a named lasting fact, a scar, a reputation, a thing known about them where they are known.

properties.name: turn life
properties.source_quote: It may turn the life, and a turn is one of these: the career ends, the career changes, a forced leaving, or the life ends.

properties.name: nothing
properties.source_quote: At nothing, a moment may only leave its record.

properties.name: a mark
properties.source_quote: At a mark, it may do one thing from the list and may not turn the life.

properties.name: a turn
properties.source_quote: At a turn, it may do up to three things and may turn the life once.

properties.name: a branch
properties.source_quote: At a branch, it may turn the life and mark it as it likes, and branches are rare because the director's own rates make them rare, not because a rule says so.
